test.description: Hillshade overzoom seam at the fractional zoom 12.6 (source maxzoom 12, 256 px tiles). Since maplibre-native#4650 a raster-dem source rounds its covering zoom, so at 12.6 it draws the z=12 tiles at overscaled zoom 14 rather than 13. Centred on the corner where the four z=12 terrain tiles meet; the slopes must be continuous across both tile boundaries.
